title: Download full-size Bandcamp album art
question: How do I get the full-size album cover from Bandcamp?
answer: Clicking the cover on a Bandcamp album page opens a 1200 pixel version, not the original. Changing the end of that image address from _10.jpg to _0.jpg gives the file the artist uploaded, at full size. The usermods script on this page does that for you: it adds a Full-size cover art link under the cover on album and track pages that opens the original image in a new tab, ready to save.
prompt: Add a link under the Bandcamp album cover that opens the full-size original image.
details:
Bandcamp serves each cover in several sizes, picked by a number at the end of the image address: `_2` is the smaller image shown on the page, `_10` is the 1200 pixel version in the pop-up, and `_0` is the original upload. The script reads the pop-up link and swaps the number for `_0`. It makes no network requests of its own.

The original can be smaller than 1200 pixels when the artist uploaded a small image, and it can be a PNG. The check loads one album page and confirms the linked image is larger than the pop-up version.

alternatives.title: Edit the image address by hand
alternatives.body: Click the cover, right-click the large image and open it in a new tab, then change the `_10` before `.jpg` in the address to `_0` and press Enter.

check.baseline: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#tralbumArt a.popupImage'); return !!a && a.checkVisibility() && /_10\.jpg$/.test(a.href) && ![...document.querySelectorAll('#tralbumArt a')].some((l) => /_0\.jpg$/.test(l.href)); })()
check.expect: (async () => { const l = [...document.querySelectorAll('#tralbumArt a')].find((a) => /_0\.jpg$/.test(a.href)); if (!l || !l.checkVisibility()) return false; const size = (src) => new Promise((r) => { const i = new Image(); i.onload = () => r(i.naturalWidth); i.onerror = () => r(0); i.src = src; }); const full = await size(l.href); const popup = await size(document.querySelector('#tralbumArt a.popupImage').href); return full > popup && popup >= 1200; })()
check.intact: (() => { const img = document.querySelector('#tralbumArt img'); return !!img && img.checkVisibility() && img.naturalWidth > 0 && [...document.querySelectorAll('#track_table .track_row_view')].filter((r) => r.checkVisibility()).length >= 10; })()
